verdict.rationale: Portkey documents an internal Logs/observability UI with request tracing, feedback, and shareable log URLs, but nothing in the evidence describes exporting logs or traces to external observability stacks (e.g., OpenTelemetry, webhooks, Datadog/Grafana integrations, or log export APIs). Missing for 10: any documented export mechanism, integration with third-party observability tools, or API for pulling logs/traces into external systems.
